raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR was part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* #44994 (merged)
* #44993 (merged)
* #44991 (merged)
* __->__ #44480 (merged)

## Motivation

Branch update: rebased onto `main` at `553836c1647b3bfbeb266b49d76ec2c9df012425`. Current head: `aba4640fc85fa75d0dfb85cd0756a7cc6e3bd422`. The original fix and author are preserved; this PR keeps its bounded one-way local-ID mapping rule. The three dependent PRs extend the per-layer contract separately. Post-rebase CPU results are listed below; original model/benchmark measurements were not rerun.

`Fp8MoEMethod.create_moe_runner` runs fp8 experts on triton when `--moe-runner-backend` is `flashinfer_cutlass` or `flashinfer_cutedsl`, since `Fp8MoEMethod` has no path on either. NVFP4 checkpoints pin `flashinfer_cutlass` on sm120, and `nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4` keeps its MTP experts in FP8 block-scaled form, so the NEXTN draft layer ends up on triton. `StandardDispatcher` only looks at the global backend when it decides whether to translate expert ids. It sees `flashinfer_cutlass`, sets `skip_local_expert_mapping`, and the triton runner gets global ids. With `--ep-size 2` each rank holds 256 of the 512 experts, so on both ranks ids 256 to 511 index past the local weights, and on rank 1 ids 0 to 255 run the wrong experts.

This is the EP2 crash in #44291 (attempts 2 and 3), and it is what the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next cookbook means when it says these experts "fault on the triton fp8 path under EP". `MoeRunner.__init__` already guards the same hazard for `hpc_ops` (it fails at startup when a quant method falls back to another runner); the flashinfer_cutlass fallback has no guard, so it runs and faults.

Reproduced on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120, PCIe only, GPU0-GPU1 `SYS`), driver 595.91.07, `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13` at a6a8c5601 (torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.1, triton 3.8.0), `nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4` @ fc694b54, `--tp-size 2 --ep-size 2 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutlass --ple-offload-embedding --disable-custom-all-reduce`, NEXTN 3/1/4:

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| no speculation, CUDA graphs | serves |
| NEXTN, CUDA graphs | `CUDA error: an illegal memory access` during draft prefill graph capture |
| NEXTN, `--disable-cuda-graph`, `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` | `Triton Error [CUDA]: an illegal memory access` in `fused_moe_kernel`, called from `Fp8MoEMethod.apply` in `_draft_extend_for_prefill` |
| NEXTN + #40172 | same crash as NEXTN with graphs: #40172 changes the mapping branch, which this layer skips |
| NEXTN + this PR | serves with CUDA graphs, GSM8K 0.975, accept length 2.94 |

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py`: `create_moe_dispatcher` passes the backend of the runner the quant method built (`quant_method.runner.runner_backend`). The layer calls `create_moe_runner` before it builds the dispatcher, so that runner is already known. Methods with no runner of their own, including wrappers that build one on an inner scheme (compressed-tensors, Quark, AWQ/GPTQ), pass `None` and keep today's behavior.
- `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/token_dispatcher/standard.py`: `StandardDispatcher` takes an optional `runner_backend`. Every flag still comes from `--moe-runner-backend`. The runner can only turn local-id mapping on: when the global backend keeps global ids (`_keeps_global_expert_ids`, the list that used to be inline) and the layer's runner does not. Under `auto`, AITER, or any layer whose runner keeps global ids, nothing changes. With LoRA and EP on a remapped layer it raises at startup, because the LoRA pool keys experts by the global backend's convention and would read the wrong adapters.
- `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_standard_dispatcher_runner_backend.py` (new, CPU): under a `flashinfer_cutlass` pin with EP2, a dispatcher built for a triton runner maps global ids to local ones and turns the other rank's experts into `-1`; `Fp8MoEMethod`'s triton fallback reaches the dispatcher through `create_moe_dispatcher`; a runner never turns mapping off (auto + `flashinfer_trtllm`); the AITER flag still follows the global backend; LoRA + EP on a remapped layer is rejected.
- `test/registered/unit/lora/test_mem_pool_ep_unit.py`: that test execs the dispatcher's `__init__` from source in a hand-built namespace, so it now also loads `_keeps_global_expert_ids` and provides `Optional` and `MoeRunnerBackendLike` for the new signature.

Not changed here: `should_use_flashinfer_cutlass_moe_fp4_allgather()` still reads the global backend (DP-attention fp4 all-gather only). Wrapper methods keep the global layout, so a wrapper whose inner scheme runs triton under a `flashinfer_cutlass` pin (Quark W8A8 FP8 per-tensor, for example) is still affected; I left that out because I could not test it.

## Validation after rebase

Head: `aba4640fc85fa75d0dfb85cd0756a7cc6e3bd422`. Rebased onto main `553836c1647b3bfbeb266b49d76ec2c9df012425`; base `main` is `553836c1647b3bfbeb266b49d76ec2c9df012425`.

- At this exact head, 2 focused CPU module(s) passed: 56 tests plus 4 reported subtests. Across all four PR heads, 15 focused modules completed 482 test executions plus 347 reported subtests, all passing.
- Each PR's full incremental tree matches the pre-rebase change applied to its rewritten base, retaining prior merge-only integration fixes. The stack remains #44480 -> #44991 -> #44993 -> #44994.
- Configured pre-commit checks passed over all 152 changed files in the full stack. Strict registration/entrypoint checks passed: 2,478 files / 3,012 registrations. CPU tests used Python 3.12.15 and Torch 2.14.1+cu130 with GPUs hidden.

GPU, full-model accuracy/throughput and full CI were not rerun for this rebase. Prior hardware measurements below remain evidence for their named earlier revisions; checked CUTLASS/Marlin/GGUF consumer sources are unchanged, which is source evidence rather than a new GPU run.

## Earlier accuracy tests (before rebase)

- New test: without this PR `6 failed, 1 passed` (the `Fp8MoEMethod` case fails on `assert not dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping`), with it `7 passed`.
- With this PR, the new test, `test_hpc_ops_runner_guard.py`, `test_flashinfer_dispatcher.py`, `test_moe_runner_config_placement.py` and `test_mem_pool_ep_unit.py`: `80 passed`.
- Server, EP2 + NEXTN + CUDA graphs + this PR: `python -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 200 --max-tokens 16384` scores 0.975, per-request accept length 2.94 (min 2.36, max 3.33).
- That server run used the first revision of this fix, which took every dispatcher flag from the runner. A review pointed out that it would change ROCm AITER BF16 MoE under EP, so I narrowed it to the version here; for this layer the two dispatch identically. The final revision was rechecked on the same pod: boots with graphs, GSM8K 50 scores 0.980, accept length 2.95.
- Without speculation, EP2 already served on main; TP2 + NEXTN with #42566 and both EP2/TP2 with the RadixArk BF16 draft also serve, so the only EP2 + NEXTN blocker on this checkpoint was this dispatcher path.

## Earlier speed tests and profiling (before rebase)

`sglang.bench_serving`, random 1024 in / 512 out, EP2 + NEXTN + CUDA graphs + this PR:

| Concurrency | Output tok/s | Median TPOT | Median TTFT | Accept length |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 181.0 | 5.21 ms | 120 ms | 2.99 |
| 16 | 950.1 | 15.41 ms | 173 ms | 2.95 |
| 64 | 1362.6 | 27.23 ms | 9500 ms | 2.90 |

There is no "before" column because main does not start in this configuration. The c=64 TTFT is queueing: the mamba state cache caps `max_running_requests` at 39 here.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (no user-facing change)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -165,6 +165,15 @@ def _get_deepep_comm_group(a2a_backend):
     return group
 
 
+def _built_runner_backend(quant_method: FusedMoEMethodBase):
+    # The layer calls create_moe_runner before building its dispatcher, so the
+    # runner the quant method actually picked is known here. Methods that keep
+    # no runner of their own (including wrappers that build one on an inner
+    # scheme) return None and the dispatcher follows --moe-runner-backend.
+    runner = quant_method.runner
+    return None if runner is None else runner.runner_backend
+
+
 def create_moe_dispatcher(
     moe_runner_config: MoeRunnerConfig,
     quant_method: FusedMoEMethodBase,
@@ -183,7 +192,9 @@ def create_moe_dispatcher(
         # StandardDispatcher is created but never invoked.
         # flashinfer_megamoe does its EP all-to-all inside the kernel, so the
         # dispatcher stays a pure noop passthrough.
-        return StandardDispatcher(moe_runner_config)
+        return StandardDispatcher(
+            moe_runner_config, runner_backend=_built_runner_backend(quant_method)
+        )
     elif (
         a2a_backend.is_deepep()
         or a2a_backend.is_mooncake()

@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@
     get_moe_runner_backend,
     should_use_flashinfer_cutlass_moe_fp4_allgather,
 )
-from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_lora, get_parallel
 from sglang.srt.utils.common import (
     get_bool_env_var,
     get_device,
@@ -44,6 +44,7 @@
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
     from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKOutput
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeRunnerBackendLike
 
 
 try:
@@ -102,8 +103,30 @@ def _map_topk_ids_to_local_experts(
     )
 
 
+def _keeps_global_expert_ids(backend: MoeRunnerBackendLike) -> bool:
+    # These runners handle EP with global expert IDs:
+    # - cutlass / cutedsl / trtllm_routed handle EP internally
+    # - mxfp4 dispatcher mapping is already global
+    # - hpc_ops consumes global ids together with rank_ep / num_expert_total
+    # - flashinfer_megamoe routes by global expert ID inside the mega kernel
+    return (
+        backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass()
+        or backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl()
+        or backend.is_flashinfer_trtllm()
+        or backend.is_experimental_sgl_trtllm()
+        or backend.is_flashinfer_trtllm_routed()
+        or backend.is_hpc_ops()
+        or backend.is_flashinfer_megamoe()
+        or backend.is_flashinfer_mxfp4()
+    )
+
+
 class StandardDispatcher(BaseDispatcher):
-    def __init__(self, moe_runner_config: MoeRunnerConfig):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe_runner_config: MoeRunnerConfig,
+        runner_backend: Optional[MoeRunnerBackendLike] = None,
+    ):
         super().__init__()
         self.moe_ep_size = get_parallel().moe_ep_size
         backend = get_moe_runner_backend()
@@ -115,21 +138,26 @@ def __init__(self, moe_runner_config: MoeRunnerConfig):
         self.use_aiter_moe_runner = backend.is_aiter() or (
             backend.is_auto() and _use_aiter and get_moe_a2a_backend().supports_aiter()
         )
-        # Skip local expert mapping when the backend handles EP with global expert IDs:
-        # - cutlass / cutedsl / trtllm_routed handle EP internally
-        # - mxfp4 dispatcher mapping is already global
-        # - hpc_ops consumes global ids together with rank_ep / num_expert_total
-        # - flashinfer_megamoe routes by global expert ID inside the mega kernel
-        self.skip_local_expert_mapping = (
-            backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass()
-            or backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl()
-            or backend.is_flashinfer_trtllm()
-            or backend.is_experimental_sgl_trtllm()
-            or backend.is_flashinfer_trtllm_routed()
-            or backend.is_hpc_ops()
-            or backend.is_flashinfer_megamoe()
-            or self.enable_flashinfer_mxfp4_moe
-        )
+        self.skip_local_expert_mapping = _keeps_global_expert_ids(backend)
+        # A built runner may enable local-ID mapping; all other flags above
+        # follow the requested backend.
+        if (
+            self.skip_local_expert_mapping
+            and runner_backend is not None
+            and not _keeps_global_expert_ids(runner_backend)
+        ):
+            # The LoRA pool keys experts by the global backend's convention, so
+            # it would read the wrong adapters for this layer under EP.
+            if self.moe_ep_size > 1 and (
+                get_lora().enable_lora or get_lora().lora_paths
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "LoRA with expert parallelism is not supported on this MoE "
+                    f"layer: --moe-runner-backend {backend.value} keeps global "
+                    f"expert ids, but the layer's quantization method runs the "
+                    f"'{runner_backend.value}' runner, which needs local ids."
+                )
+            self.skip_local_expert_mapping = False
         self.num_experts = moe_runner_config.num_experts
         self.num_local_experts = moe_runner_config.num_local_experts
         self.num_local_shared_experts = moe_runner_config.num_fused_shared_experts

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+"""StandardDispatcher must give local expert ids to a runner that needs them.
+
+Fp8MoEMethod runs its fp8 experts on triton when --moe-runner-backend is
+flashinfer_cutlass, which NVFP4 checkpoints with fp8 MTP experts pin on sm120.
+A dispatcher that only reads the global backend keeps global expert ids for
+that layer, and under EP the triton kernel indexes experts the rank does not
+hold (an illegal memory access on the draft extend of
+nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 at --tp 2 --ep 2).
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.base import MoeRunnerConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher import standard
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput

+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="stage-b-test-cpu-intel")
+
+NUM_EXPERTS = 8
+NUM_LOCAL_EXPERTS = 4
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def ep2_rank0(monkeypatch):
+    moe = get_flags().moe
+    saved = (moe.runner_backend, moe.a2a_backend)
+    moe.a2a_backend = MoeA2ABackend.NONE
+    monkeypatch.setattr(standard, "get_device", lambda: "cpu")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        standard,
+        "get_parallel",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(moe_ep_size=2, moe_ep_rank=0),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        standard,
+        "get_lora",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(enable_lora=False, lora_paths=None),
+        raising=False,
+    )
+    yield moe
+    moe.runner_backend, moe.a2a_backend = saved
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def cutlass_pin(ep2_rank0):
+    ep2_rank0.runner_backend = MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTLASS
+    return ep2_rank0
+
+
+def _config():
+    return MoeRunnerConfig(
+        num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+        num_local_experts=NUM_LOCAL_EXPERTS,
+        num_fused_shared_experts=0,
+        top_k=2,
+    )
+
+
+def _dispatch_ids(dispatcher, topk_ids):
+    topk_output = StandardTopKOutput(
+        topk_weights=torch.ones(topk_ids.shape, device=topk_ids.device),
+        topk_ids=topk_ids,
+        router_logits=torch.zeros(
+            topk_ids.shape[0], NUM_EXPERTS, device=topk_ids.device
+        ),
+    )
+    hidden_states = torch.zeros(topk_ids.shape[0], 16, device=topk_ids.device)
+    return dispatcher.dispatch(hidden_states, topk_output).topk_output.topk_ids
+
+
+def test_global_backend_still_decides_without_a_runner(cutlass_pin):
+    dispatcher = standard.StandardDispatcher(_config())
+    assert dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping
+
+
+def test_triton_runner_gets_local_ids_under_cutlass_pin(cutlass_pin):
+    dispatcher = standard.StandardDispatcher(
+        _config(), runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.TRITON
+    )
+    assert not dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping
+
+    topk_ids = torch.tensor([[0, 5], [3, 7]], dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu")
+    local_ids = _dispatch_ids(dispatcher, topk_ids)
+    # Rank 0 holds global experts 0-3; experts on the other rank become the
+    # -1 drop sentinel instead of indexing past the local weights.
+    assert local_ids.tolist() == [[0, -1], [3, -1]]
+
+
+def test_runner_that_keeps_global_ids_changes_nothing(cutlass_pin):
+    dispatcher = standard.StandardDispatcher(
+        _config(), runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTLASS
+    )
+    assert dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping
+
+
+def test_runner_never_turns_mapping_off(ep2_rank0):
+    # Under auto a built runner is never AUTO, e.g. ModelOpt NVFP4 resolving
+    # to flashinfer_trtllm on sm100; the global layout must stay in charge.
+    ep2_rank0.runner_backend = MoeRunnerBackend.AUTO
+    dispatcher = standard.StandardDispatcher(
+        _config(), runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_TRTLLM
+    )
+    assert not dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping
+
+
+def test_aiter_flag_follows_global_backend(ep2_rank0, monkeypatch):
+    # Unquantized MoE on ROCm builds a triton runner next to its AITER one;
+    # the AITER expert mask must still be built from the global backend.
+    ep2_rank0.runner_backend = MoeRunnerBackend.AUTO
+    monkeypatch.setattr(standard, "_use_aiter", True)
+    dispatcher = standard.StandardDispatcher(
+        _config(), runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.TRITON
+    )
+    assert dispatcher.use_aiter_moe_runner
+
+
+def test_lora_with_ep_is_rejected_on_a_remapped_layer(cutlass_pin, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        standard,
+        "get_lora",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(enable_lora=True, lora_paths=None),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="LoRA"):
+        standard.StandardDispatcher(_config(), runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.TRITON)
+
+
+def test_fp8_triton_fallback_reaches_the_dispatcher(cutlass_pin):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import create_moe_dispatcher
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8MoEMethod
+
+    method = object.__new__(Fp8MoEMethod)
+    method.is_fp4_expert = False
+    method.create_moe_runner(SimpleNamespace(), _config())
+    assert method.runner.runner_backend.is_triton()
+
+    dispatcher = create_moe_dispatcher(_config(), method)
+    assert not dispatcher.skip_local_expert_mapping
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

issue_comments.body: @ch-wan could you take a look when you get a chance? This is the EP2 crash from #44291: the fp8 MTP experts fall back to triton under the `flashinfer_cutlass` pin, but the dispatcher still hands them global expert ids. With this, EP2 + NEXTN serves on 2x RTX PRO 6000 (GSM8K 0.980, accept length 2.95). It also needs the run-ci label for CI to start.

@adi-suresh01  Thank you for your contribution. I'm coincidentally fixing a broader issue (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44993) and my agent found this related one. I will stack my PRs over yours. You can ping me on slack as I do not regularly check github inbox.
Thanks @ch-wan, makes sense for it to sit under the layer contract work. I'll leave the branch as you rebased it and reach out on Slack.
